questions.stem: Pointing to a woman, Rahul says 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the woman related to Rahul?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Rahul's grandfather's only son = Rahul's father. The woman is the daughter of Rahul's father = Rahul's sister.

questions.stem: A is the brother of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: B is correct. A's mother is C (since C is mother of B, and A is B's brother → same mother). C's father is D → D is A's maternal grandfather → A is D's grandson.

questions.stem: Introducing a man, a woman said 'His mother is the only daughter of my father.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'The only daughter of my father' = the woman herself (she is her own father's daughter). So the man's mother = the woman herself → the man is the woman's son.

questions.stem: P and Q are brothers. R and S are sisters. P's son is S's brother. How is Q related to R?
questions.explanation: C is correct. P's son is S's brother → P is the father of S and R (since R and S are sisters). P and Q are brothers → Q is P's brother → Q is the uncle of R and S.

questions.stem: 'A + B' means A is the father of B. 'A – B' means A is the wife of B. 'A × B' means A is the brother of B. 'A ÷ B' means A is the daughter of B. If P ÷ R × Q, what is Q to P?
questions.explanation: B is correct. P ÷ R = P is the daughter of R. R × Q = R is the brother of Q. So P's father is R, and R's brother is Q. Therefore Q is P's uncle.

questions.stem: In a family of 6, there are parents, one grandfather, one grandmother, and two children. If Priya is the mother and Ravi is the father, who could be Priya's mother-in-law?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Priya is the mother; Ravi is the father. Priya's mother-in-law = Ravi's mother = the grandmother in the family (she is the parent of the parents' generation).

questions.stem: Looking at a portrait, Vishal said 'Her mother is the wife of my father's son.' Vishal has no brothers. Who is in the portrait?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Vishal has no brothers → 'my father's son' = Vishal himself. 'The wife of Vishal' = Vishal's wife. The portrait person's mother is Vishal's wife → the portrait person is Vishal's daughter.

questions.stem: A says to B: 'The man who married my mother is your father.' What is B to A?
questions.explanation: A is correct. 'The man who married my mother' = A's father. A's father is also B's father → A and B have the same father → they are siblings (brother or sister).

questions.stem: Meera's brother's father's wife's daughter is Priya. What is Priya's relationship to Meera?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Meera's brother's father = Meera's father (they share the same father). Meera's father's wife = Meera's mother. Meera's mother's daughter = Meera's sister = Priya.

questions.stem: If X is the brother of Y, Y is the sister of Z, and Z is the son of W, how is W related to X?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Z is Y's brother; Y is X's sister. So X, Y, Z are all siblings. Z is W's son → W is the parent of Z → W is also the parent of X and Y. W is X's mother or father.
